svg.title: One nat is a factor of e, and one bit is a factor of 2
svg.desc: Two bars measured in nats from a shared zero. The longer bar is a factor of e and is labeled 1 nat. The shorter bar is a factor of 2 and is labeled ln 2, about 0.693 nats, which equals 1 bit.
svg.text: A nat measures a factor with the natural log
Bar length is the change in nats. A factor of e is 1 nat. A factor of 2 is about 0.693 nats, which is 1 bit.
A Lyapunov exponent is a long-run average log growth rate; single steps can stretch more or less.
At ln 2 nats per step, a tiny distance doubles per step on average. Entropy uses the same unit.
